# Sum of Integers with Maximum Digit Range.

@example 907 and 309 both have digit range 9 - 0 = 9; 52 has 3 and 18 has 7.
[52,907,309,18]
=> 1216

@example Every entry has digit range 0, so all of them are added, 66 twice.
[66,2222,66]
=> 2354

@example The 0 in 270 is its smallest digit, so its range is 7; 3141 and 58 have 3.
[3141,270,58]
=> 270

# A single entry.
[10]
=> 10

# The largest value has range 1, which beats 99999 (range 0).
[100000,99999]
=> 100000

# No zeros, and the largest digits differ: ranges 4, 7 and 0. Taking the
# smallest digit as 0 would give 9, 8 and 2 instead.
[59,81,22]
=> 81

# No 9s: ranges 1 and 2. Taking the largest digit as 9 would give 6 and 4.
[34,57]
=> 57

# A 0 inside the number and at its end counts as its smallest digit
# (5070 has range 7; skipping zeros would tie it with 86 at 2).
[5070,86]
=> 5070

[300,12]
=> 300

# The largest range comes last, after smaller ones and a tie between them:
# the sum must start over at 19.
[12,13,24,19]
=> 19

# The largest range comes first.
[91,23,45,67]
=> 91

# All ranges 0: every entry is added.
[11,22,33333,99999]
=> 133365

# The same value three times at the largest range: each copy is added.
[409,409,409,18]
=> 1227

# Different values tie at range 9, two others tie at 8.
[190,908,80,19]
=> 1098

# 100 entries of 10^5: the largest possible answer, 10^7.
[100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000,100000]
=> 10000000

[777,99999,777]
